summaries.zh: ContextGate — a context-folding gate plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) / Cordis. Intercepts LLM request streams and folds oversized conversation history into a summary to keep context length under control.
summaries.en: ContextGate — a context-folding gate plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) / Cordis. Intercepts LLM request streams and folds oversized conversation history into a summary to keep context length under control.
